title: Edge traffic
description: Who calls which service through the Cilium Gateways, and how it answers. Rate, errors and duration come from Hubble's counters, callers and single requests from the Gateway request log.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

links.title: Network flows
links.tooltip: Raw connections to the hosts, with source location

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Node whose Gateway Envoy served the request.

list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.description: Part of the client address or of a pod's <namespace>/<workload>, for example 134.101. or gitlab-runner. Empty shows every client.

list.name: host
list.label: Host name
list.description: Part of the requested host name, for example nix-cache.

list.name: path
list.label: Path
list.description: Part of the requested path, for example /nar/.

list.name: status
list.label: Status
list.description: Status code or its first digits, for example 5 for every server error or 404. Narrows the panels fed by the request log.

panels.description: Requests per second for the selected services and nodes.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Every client of the selection, busiest first. A pod appears as <namespace>/<workload>, everything else by address. Select a client to narrow the dashboard to it, or to follow its raw connections.

targets.expr: _stream:{service.name="hubble"} backend.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) client.name:~"$client" server.address:~"$host" url.path:~"$path" edge.event:=response http.response.status_code:~"^$status" | stats by (client.name, client.network, geo.country_name, geo.city_name) count() requests, count() if (http.response.status_code:>=400) errors, count_uniq(backend.service) services, quantile(0.95, duration_ms) p95, max(_time) last | math round(last / 1000000) as last | sort by (requests desc) | limit 200

panels.title: Requests by client network
panels.description: Requests from the internet, the house LAN, the tailnet and pods of the cluster.

targets.expr: _stream:{service.name="hubble"} backend.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) client.name:~"$client" server.address:~"$host" url.path:~"$path" edge.event:=response http.response.status_code:~"^$status" | stats by (client.network) count() requests | sort by (requests desc)

panels.title: User agents
panels.description: Software behind the requests, as the client names itself. Bots, uptime checks and nix clients stand out here.
